thesis: A deleveraging, high-return domain and SMB-software franchise with a 33.7% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a revenue decline that growing bookings and high-end guidance do not show.
reason: Thesis intact: margins and FCF at 2-year highs, leverage down, cash multiples below their 5-year minimums. The position already sits at its conviction size and cash is near the floor, so hold rather than add; AI disintermediation is watched via bookings and margins.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year improvement from 12.5% (FY2021) to 28.7%.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, erasing the post-2023 step-up (FY2024 20.4%).
TTM FCF margin falls below 25%, under the FY2024 level of 27.6%, showing the cash gains were transitory.
Total bookings growth in the 10-Q/earnings release turns negative for two consecutive quarters (AI substitution showing in demand), or net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x.
